articles.title: Operationalizing FDT

curriculum.summary: This article operationalizes functional decision theory (FDT), exploring how to define the logical do-operator, logical causality, and its interaction with anthropic updating, assuming knowledge of decision theory and causal graphs. articles.title: How well do models follow their constitutions?
